title: MM6 Guard
description: An adult human town guard, lean ordinary adult proportions, face largely concealed by a rounded slightly pointed iron helmet with central brass reinforcement and nasal guard and a dark protective face guard/coif with narrow eye openings. A short-sleeved gold-bronze ring-mail hauberk reaching upper thighs over navy blue cloth short sleeves, bare light warm forearms and hands, plain dark brown leather belt, dark teal green trousers, brown leather shoes. Holds a long wooden-shafted halberd/poleaxe low and approximately horizontal at hip level in his right hand. The dark iron axe/spear head is foreshortened in the frontal view but the side views clearly show the long brown shaft behind his body; preserve that polearm, head shape and native grip exactly. Small blue binding detail near the head. Preserve the original modest helmet shape: no horns, no gigantic spikes, no pauldrons, no plate armor, no shield. Fine interlinked mail rings, worn metal, wool cloth and leather with muted realistic baked shading. No new ornaments. The guard is sturdy but not bodybuilder bulky.
regions: Navy sleeve cloth and small blue hilt detail; gold-bronze mail and helmet metal; dark teal trousers; warm skin/brown leather each keep distinct native colors. Preserve metallic shading, and never turn the polearm into a colored glow.
